weapon.d: Effective against flying foes. If foe's Def ≥ foe's Res+5, deals +7 damage.
Effective against flying foes. If foe's Def ≥ foe's Res+5, deals +7 damage.

Effective against flying foes. At start of combat, if unit's HP ≥ 25%, grants Atk/Spd/Def/Res+4 to unit during combat, deals damage = 10% of unit's Spd (including when dealing damage with a Special triggered before combat), and calculates damage using the lower of foe's Def or Res.

Grants Spd/Res+2 to adjacent allies during combat.
